timing: Frozen after the MC-RVE validation sensitivity selected m=6 and before any SC-RVE m=6 optimization. Test and probe arrays are excluded.

feature_selection.candidate_couplings: sorted unique values {0, p-0.5, 2*p-1}, and similarly for q; loop order theta,p,q,b,c

common_start_projection.rule: Project powers first; divide original b,c by the new bounds 2*p-1,2*q-1, clip ratios, then reconstruct b,c. Applied to the entire candidate bank BEFORE selection, equally for fixed and learned starts.

feature_selection.support_rule: Union of positive supports from fit energy/stress NNLS and a separate reference-tangent NNLS, excluding the two analytic volume columns.
feature_selection.overflow_rule: If support exceeds 32, rank support by fit_coefficient*fit_column_norm/fit_target_norm + reference_coefficient*reference_column_norm/reference_target_norm; descending score, ascending candidate index for ties. Otherwise retain support in ascending candidate order.
feature_selection.qr_rule: Rows linspace(0,4*N_fit-1,600,dtype=int) of the weighted fit matrix; exclude two analytic columns; divide columns by max(norm,1e-10); scipy economic pivoted QR. Append unselected pivots to reach exactly 32.
feature_selection.subset_refit: Refit nonnegative coefficients on the selected 32 features plus quadratic and logarithmic volume columns using all three training-objective terms, including reference tangent weight 0.02. Subtract the fixed epsilon growth term from targets in this final refit. No validation labels enter.
feature_selection.limitations: Finite dictionary and greedy diversity heuristic, not an optimal-feature theorem; fitting the fixed embedding to fit labels is intentional. Interior projection slightly changes boundary candidates to make a genuinely common finite-parameter learned start possible.

scaling.stress_denominator: mean(s_fit^2), over all samples and 3 components
scaling.feature_center: Current exact undeformed value 1/p+1/q, including during learned-feature fitting
scaling.feature_scale: max(max_fit(abs(z-z0)),1e-4) per selected feature; identical for both cores and fixed/learned; frozen at initialization, never refitted during optimization
scaling.metric_floors: Energy floor = fraction*RMS(W_fit); stress-vector floor = fraction*sqrt(mean(sum(S_fit^2,axis=1))); tangent-matrix floor = stress-vector floor/strain_scale. Component stress RMSE uses max(component_fit_RMS,fraction*global_component_fit_RMS). Per-state relative distributions use these floors; aggregate errors use the actual target norm. Zero-strain reference is reported separately. No fit tangents except the reference anchor are used.

Free.initialization: Xavier uniform linear weights and zero biases, constructed in float64; reset strain/feature buffers to exact saved float64 scales after constructor
Free.reference_correction: Subtract raw reference energy and its full affine engineering-strain gradient; no polyconvexity claim

constrained.initialization: initialize(shared_subset_coefficients, nonlinear); use the same reset RNG seed for fixed and learned within each core
constrained.calibration: First 500 fit states in saved order. Compute nonlinear stress relative to the shared affine NNLS response; scale only the final nonlinear branch by min(1,0.05*norm(s_target)/max(norm(s_nonlinear),1e-12)). Apply the same deterministic procedure to both variants; verify equal initial responses.
constrained.positive_transform: softplus; ICNN positive weights additionally have a 1e-10 floor; alpha,beta have the volume floor

ICNN.connections: Nonnegative input-to-every-hidden-layer, hidden-to-hidden, input-to-output and hidden-to-output weights; unrestricted biases

ICKAN.basis: Integrated triangular hats: B''_k(x)=max(1-abs((x-k)/h),0), h=0.48; B and B' vanish below k-h; linear tail above k+h
ICKAN.coefficients: softplus linear and hat coefficients, unrestricted node biases, positive direct input-to-output skip

models.controlled_claim: Only fixed-versus-learned within a core is a controlled embedding ablation. Widths differ between cores; report actual parameter counts, times and all seeds, not a parameter-matched ICNN/ICKAN/Free comparison.

execution.random_seeds: Set Python, NumPy and torch to the declared run seed independently for every run; no minibatch shuffling
execution.batch: All 4208 fitting states per objective evaluation
execution.autograd: Keep parameter dependencies through reference corrections and second strain derivatives; no detach of learned feature parameters or reference sensitivities

lbfgs.validation: After each outer call; do not reset optimizer history between calls
lbfgs.budget_note: 400 is an upper bound on internal iterations, not a bound on closure calls. Strong-Wolfe bracketing may exceed the nominal max_eval. Record actual n_iter and func_evals from optimizer state; never label 40 calls as 400 completed iterations.

checkpoints.score: Validation stress MSE divided by the frozen FIT stress denominator; no energy/tangent term in selection
checkpoints.candidates: Initialization, each 10 Adam steps, each LBFGS outer call
checkpoints.tie: Strictly lower score only; earliest checkpoint wins equal scores
checkpoints.final: Minimum validation score across both phases; restore it before saving
checkpoints.persistence: Save resumable current optimizer/scheduler/RNG state and distinct best state every 200 Adam steps and after each LBFGS call; record hashes of data, recipe, feature table, scaling and all imported model sources
checkpoints.failure: Stop and retain failed run and diagnostics for any nonfinite objective/gradient/score or constraint violation; do not change seeds, silently restart or tune on reserved labels
checkpoints.evaluation_gate: All 15 final checkpoints, all declared seeds and models, must be hash-locked before loading reserved test/path prediction targets
checkpoints.reporting: All seeds plus mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1); curves use median-validation seed with seed-number tie break

scope: SC-RVE m=6 learned-feature preparation only. Feature selection uses fit and reference arrays; validation, test, and probe labels do not select features.
